recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結被膜與周圍脂肪完整，實質內有數個濾泡；被膜下竇與中間竇內可見淡染、較大的細胞群聚，與深藍色的小淋巴球區形成對比，提示腫瘤沿淋巴竇浸潤。
features: Lymph node with fibrous capsule and perinodal adipose tissue
Several follicles with germinal centers in the cortex
Paler clusters of larger cells within subcapsular and intermediate sinuses
Sinusoidal distribution of the pale cell clusters between darker lymphoid areas
Small lymphoid aggregate within the capsule/perinodal tissue
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a lymph node shows an intact fibrous capsule with perinodal fat and several cortical follicles with germinal centers. Pale-staining clusters of larger cells are present in the subcapsular and intermediate sinuses, contrasting with the darker small-lymphocyte compartments. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. Findings suggest a sinusoidal infiltrate of large cells, consistent with extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma in the context of the case.

ddx.vs: Similar sinusoidal pattern but the cells are CD30/ALK or T-cell positive and HHV8-negative.
Subcapsular sinus deposits are keratin or melanocytic marker positive and CD45/MUM1/HHV8-negative.
Sinuses are distended by bland histiocytes with low-grade nuclei rather than atypical large lymphoid cells.
